title: QCA988x Target Full Polling Hooks (32 Function Pointers) Instruction-Level Dissection

handle_struct_fields.+0x00: flags (bit 1=0x02 custom pool alloc, bit 2=0x04 pause WAL TX queue, bit 3=0x08 force NOACK, bit 4=0x10 TX gate)

ubnt_poll_ptp_init.role: Sets g_ubnt_active_hooks_ptr (0x00411aec) to Initial Hooks (0x0040f608, 15/32 non-null slots) at boot.

platform_uninstall_hooks.role: Reverts g_ubnt_active_hooks_ptr (0x00411aec) back to Initial Hooks (0x0040f608) when polling is disabled.

platform_install_hooks.role: Switches g_ubnt_active_hooks_ptr (0x00411aec) to Full Polling Hooks (0x0040f688, 32/32 non-null slots) when HT_COMM (0x009b1c80 @ 0x009b1d25) enables the airMAX TDMA state machine.

rom_wal_hooks_registration_0x00988fb0.role: Invokes Slot 0 (on_pdev_init) via g_ubnt_active_hooks_ptr (0x00411aec), then passes &g_ubnt_active_hooks_ptr (0x00411aec) and g_ubnt_hooks_handle (0x00411af0) to ROM WAL attach (*0x0040d0e0).

key_findings.claim: All 32 function pointers of the QCA988x Full Polling Hooks table (0x0040f688 PtP, 0x0040fb48 AP, 0x0040fbf8 STA in WA.v8.7.25; shifted by +0x0d40 to 0x004103e8, 0x004108a8, 0x00410958 in XC.v8.7.25) have been disassembled to instruction level and mapped to their exact WMI, HTT, and WAL TX/RX hooks.

At boot, ubnt_poll_ptp_init (0x009af28f) points g_ubnt_active_hooks_ptr (0x00411aec) to Initial Hooks (0x0040f608, 15/32 non-null slots: [0..11, 19, 23, 25]), leaving data-plane TDMA scheduling/gating slots [12..18, 20..22, 24, 26..31] NULL. Only when HT_COMM (0x009b1c80 @ 0x009b1d25) calls platform_install_hooks (0x009af2f8) does 0x00411aec switch to Full Polling Hooks (0x0040f688, 32/32 slots).

At 0x00988fcc..0x00989006, the target firmware passes &g_ubnt_active_hooks_ptr (0x00411aec) and g_ubnt_hooks_handle (0x00411af0) directly into the QCA988x ROM WAL attach routine (*0x0040d0e0), which is how ROM-resident TX/RX functions invoke Slots 12, 15, 17, 18, 19, 20, 23, 24, 25, and 30 without direct call sites in RAM seg[3].

pillar_a_ground_up_re_and_knob_catalog.evidence: Instruction-level Xtensa disassembly of all 32 hooks across 9 firmware blobs (WA.v8.7.25, XC.v8.7.25, WA.v8.7.11).

pillar_b_hyperresearch_and_scholar_react.evidence: Cross-verified WAL/HTT/WMI hook semantics with Stage 138A PtP STA data-gate dissection.

pillar_d_scientific_pareto_validation.pareto_delta: 100% (32/32) hook slot attribution with zero unresolved pointers.
